reason: First month is free and I only pay if my boys actually use it, so I lose nothing by letting the founder set it up. If it stops me phoning eight technicians all day, ₹999 is less than one day's wage for one technician.
objection: My technicians speak fast Tanglish with the compressor running and traffic below. If the report comes out wrong and I have to correct every one, it is more work than WhatsApp, and I am back to calling them.
would_change_my_mind: If in the free month the reports from the rooftop come out wrong more often than right, or the boys refuse to press the button, I will not pay.
